text:
jordan: Hey team — after rotating our API key yesterday our CI started failing with 401 invalid_api_key. We updated the secret in 1Password and the new key is the one shown in the dashboard (last 4: 1234). curl to /v1/generate returns 
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"API key not found"}
Any suggestions?

sam: Hi Jordan — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact curl you used (remove the actual key) and also try printing the raw bytes of the key from your CI/1Password? Sometimes clipboard managers add stray chars. Example commands to run: 

# print hex bytes
printf '%s' "$API_KEY" | hexdump -C

# or strip trailing semicolon in bash as a workaround
export API_KEY=$(echo "$API_KEY" | sed 's/;$//')

jordan: thanks, here's the sanitized curl I used (key replaced):
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123...' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -i
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"API key not found"}

I ran the hexdump in the CI container (printed only last bytes):
00000000  73 6b 5f 6c 69 76 65 5f  41 42 43 31 32 33 3b        |sk_live_ABC123;|
0000000d

sam: That 0x3b at the end is a semicolon (`;`). Looks like the copied value in 1Password (or a clipboard helper) appended a trailing semicolon. Our key matching is exact, so the extra byte makes the token invalid. Two options: 1) quick fix in CI: strip trailing punctuation (sed 's/[[:punct:]]*$//'), 2) rotate the key and re-save the clean value into 1Password.

jordan: Strip workaround worked locally, pipeline green after adjusting export. Could you confirm if this is a known issue with 1Password or macOS clipboard? I copied the key from a secure note that had semicolons on the same line.

maria: Not a platform bug on our side, but we should add docs. I'll create a short FAQ entry and a tiny UX tweak: when users click "Copy" in the dashboard we'll trim trailing whitespace and common punctuation (.;,) before copying. We won't silently strip server-side because that could hide real token mismatches — but we can surface a validation hint in the dashboard next to rotated keys.

sam: Filed support ticket #SUP-1428 to add docs + dashboard copy trimming. For immediate triage we also added a KB note to recommend `printf '%s' "$API_KEY" | hexdump -C` to inspect non-printable bytes.

jordan: Rotated the key and stored the new value in 1Password (copied via the dashboard copy button this time). CI is green. Thanks for the quick help :thumbsup: 

sam: Great — marking this thread resolved. If you hit any more auth quirks ping support and paste the hexdump output.

maria: Follow-up: we'll propose the copy-button trim in the next release notes and add the KB link in the dashboard copy modal.

jordan: Thanks all :raised_hands:
